culture.text: Cloetta describes its workplace as professional, respectful and informal, with fun, collaboration and initiative at the centre.
Brands include Red Band, Venco, Sportlife, KING Peppermint, Läkerol and The Jelly Bean Factory, sold in over 60 countries and made at six sites.

open.text: Cloetta Holland B.V. and Cloetta Finance Holland B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.

growth.text: Cloetta had about 2,600 staff and revenue of SEK 5.7 billion in 2020.
Its margins rose strongly in Q2 2026.

worth_knowing.text: The Dutch company is owned by Swedish Cloetta AB.
